lat: tmennit had l-khidma mn zman
en: I wished for this job a long time ago.

lat: ma tmennitsh had l-mushkil yweqe3
en: I did not wish for this problem to happen.

lat: nta tmenniti had l-fer7a l sa7bek
en: You wished this joy for your friend.

lat: 3lesh ma tmennitish l-khir l khuya?
en: Why didn't you wish good for my brother?

lat: nti tmenniti dar kbira f r-rbat
en: You (f.) wished for a big house in Rabat.

lat: wash ma tmennitish 7aja zwina l-yum?
ar: واش ما تمنيتيش حاجة زوينة اليوم؟
en: Didn't you (f.) wish for something nice today?

lat: huwa tmenna n-naja7 l wladu
en: He wished success for his children.

lat: huwa ma tmennash ykhesru l-match
en: He didn't wish for them to lose the match.

lat: hiya tmennat tumubil jdida
en: She wished for a new car.

lat: hiya ma tmennatsh had l-7ala kamla
ar: هي ما تمناتش هاد الحالة كاملة
en: She did not wish for this whole situation.

lat: 7na tmennina l-khir l kulshi
en: We wished good for everyone.

lat: 7na ma tmenninash had s-sde3 kamel
ar: حنا ما تمنيناش هاد الصداع كامل
en: We didn't wish for all this noise.

lat: ntuma tmennitu 3otla zwina hna
en: You (pl.) wished for a nice holiday here.

lat: ntuma ma tmennitush tsafru f l-berd
en: You (pl.) didn't wish to travel in the cold.

lat: huma tmennaw l-fer7a l khti
en: They wished happiness for my sister.

lat: huma ma tmennawsh had l-khabar l-qbi7
ar: هما ما تمناوش هاد الخبر القبيح
en: They didn't wish for this bad news.

lat: dima kantmenna l-khir l s7abi
en: I always wish the best for my friends.

lat: ana ma kantmennash l-mushkil l 7ed
en: I don't wish trouble on anyone.

lat: ash kattmenna f had l-3id?
en: What do you wish for on this Eid?

lat: nta ma kattmennash t3ish f l-mdina
en: You do not hope to live in the city.

lat: shnu kattmennay l 3id miladek?
en: What do you (f.) wish for your birthday?

lat: nti ma kattmennaysh terj3i l d-dar daba
ar: نتي ما كتتمنايش ترجعي للدار دابا
en: You (f.) don't wish to return home now.

lat: huwa kaytmenna yshuf 3a'iltu qrib
en: He hopes to see his family soon.

lat: baba ma kaytmennash ybdel l-khidma
en: My father doesn't wish to change jobs.

lat: mmi kattmenna l-khir l kul wladha
en: My mother wishes good for all her children.

lat: hiya ma kattmennash tebqa hna bu7dha
ar: هي ما كتتمناش تبقى هنا بوحدها
en: She doesn't wish to stay here alone.

lat: 7na kantmennaw n-naja7 l kulshi
en: We wish success to everyone.

lat: 7na ma kantmennawsh nshufu l-khedma waqfa
ar: حنا ما كنتمناوش نشوفو الخدمة واقفة
en: We do not wish to see the work stopped.

lat: wash ntuma kattmennaw l-fer7a l wladkum?
en: Do you (pl.) wish happiness for your children?

lat: ntuma ma kattmennawsh tsafru b t-tran
en: You (pl.) don't wish to travel by train.

lat: l-asatida kaytmennaw n-naja7 l t-tlamed
en: The teachers wish success for the students.

lat: l-jiran ma kaytmennawsh s-sde3 f l-lil
en: The neighbours don't wish for noise at night.

lat: ghadi ntmenna l-khir l kul wa7ed
en: I am going to wish the best for everyone.

lat: ma ghadish ntmenna had s-s3uba l khuya
ar: ما غاديش نتمنا هاد الصعوبة لخويا
en: I will not wish this difficulty for my brother.

lat: nta ghadi ttmenna shi 7aja zwina
ar: نتا غادي تتمنا شي حاجة زوينة
en: You are going to wish for something nice.

lat: nta ma ghadish ttmenna l-khesara l sa7bek
ar: نتا ما غاديش تتمنا الخسارة لصاحبك
en: You will not wish loss upon your friend.

lat: nti ghadi ttmennay l-khir l khtek
en: You (f.) are going to wish the best for your sister.

lat: nti ma ghadish ttmennay had l-mushkil l khtek
ar: نتي ما غاديش تتمناي هاد المشكل لختك
en: You (f.) are not going to wish this problem on your sister.

lat: huwa ghadi ytmenna dar jdida f d-dar l-bida
ar: هو غادي يتمنا دار جديدة فالدار البيضاء
en: He will wish for a new house in Casablanca.

lat: huwa ma ghadish ytmenna l-mushkil l weld 3emmu
ar: هو ما غاديش يتمنا المشكل لولد عمو
en: He will not wish trouble for his cousin.

lat: hiya ghadi ttmenna safar zwin l uruppa
ar: هي غادي تتمنا سفر زوين لأوروبا
en: She is going to wish for a nice trip to Europe.

lat: hiya ma ghadish ttmenna l-we7da f d-dar
ar: هي ما غاديش تتمنا الوحدة فالدار
en: She will not wish for loneliness in the house.

lat: 7na ghadi ntmennaw n-naja7 l kul l-ferqa
ar: حنا غادي نتمناو النجاح لكل الفرقة
en: We will wish success for the whole team.

lat: 7na ma ghadish ntmennaw l-khedma t7bes
ar: حنا ما غاديش نتمناو الخدمة تحبس
en: We will not wish for the work to stop.

lat: ntuma ghadi ttmennaw l-fer7a l 3a'iltkum
en: You (pl.) are going to wish happiness for your family.

lat: ntuma ma ghadish ttmennaw had t-t3til l-yum
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تتمناو هاد التعطيل اليوم
en: You (pl.) will not wish for this delay today.

lat: huma ghadi ytmennaw l-khir l j-jiran
en: They will wish good things for the neighbours.

lat: huma ma ghadish ytmennaw l-mushkil ykber
ar: هما ما غاديش يتمناو المشكل يكبر
en: They will not wish for the problem to grow.
